title: Runtime Decision Evaluator and Universal Authorizer Shim
creator: Mateo Ruiz
description: Problem: Our current authorization footprint is fragmented: API servers, runtime inferencing daemons, and the Console each have bespoke checks and copies of policy logic. This causes drift, audit gaps, and makes RBAC v2 rollouts error-prone. Goal: Build a single policy evaluation runtime (Decision Evaluator) that can run language-agnostic policy bundles as WASM modules or an expression DSL, paired with a lightweight Universal Authorizer Shim that integrates with API gateways, the serving runtime, and console backends. The evaluator must provide fast decision latency (p50 < 1ms for local cache, p99 < 10ms in worst-case), strong audit traces (request -> decision correlation id, policy version, explaining evidence), and a migration path from the legacy authorizers.
acceptance_criteria: Decision Evaluator can load a policy bundle (WASM or DSL) and respond to authorization queries over gRPC/HTTP with JSON attributes
Universal Authorizer Shim library available in Go and TypeScript with a stable interface for HTTP/gRPC middleware
Audit events emitted for every authorization decision with correlation id, attributes snapshot, decision, policy_version and can be routed to our audit pipeline
Performance: local-cache hit p50 < 1ms and p99 < 4ms under 1000 rps of mixed queries in synthetic benchmark
Fallback behavior: when evaluator unavailable, shim can be configured for fail-closed or fail-open per route; configuration documented
E2E rollout plan exists with canary traffic, gradual policy pinning, and automated regression checks tied to Console UI
comments: 2025-01-28 Mateo Ruiz: Initial proposal posted. Key idea: move away from duplicated policy engines to a single decision runtime with WASM hooks so teams can author policies in their preferred language and compile to a canonical runtime format.

2025-02-03 Asha Patel: Spike complete. Implemented a PoC WASM host using wazero. Observed cold-start penalty ~12ms for first policy load, subsequent queries average 0.7ms. Will add warm-pool and prefetch of hot bundles.

2025-02-10 Priya Menon (Security): Request security review. Concerns: WASM sandbox escapes and policy bundle signing/attestation. Proposal: sign bundles with our KMS key and verify on load; run WASM in restricted host with policies limiting syscalls.

2025-02-18 Design review (Lena Cho): Console UX hooks approved. Need a lightweight policy viewer in Console showing active policy version and last-decision sample along with explain traces for admins.

2025-02-24 Engineering: Built Go shim and TS shim prototypes. Go shim integrates as HTTP middleware and gRPC interceptor. TS shim exposes an express middleware and a Next.js server hook for Console routes.
2025-03-01 Perf testing: 1k rps mixed attribute queries against local cache in k8s cluster: p50=0.9ms p95=3.1ms p99=6.8ms. Memory footprint per evaluator pod ~60MB with two loaded bundles.

2025-03-03 Asha Patel: Security review follow-up scheduled. Added dependency on key rotation story for bundle signing (ENG-21012). Preparing draft rollout runbook and canary automation for next cycle.
